ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.08:0.92 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary macro-region is a contiguous low-intensity dark field; high-intensity white annular and circular blobs (radius 3-10 pixels) are mapped primarily to the distal half of both lobes, with the highest density in the upper-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 32 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to ~15% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitudes of variations range from 4 to 22 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating at the median notch and sweeping toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the central and outer lobe surfaces, consistent with barnacle detachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity, textured calcareous clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel cluster localized at the center-bottom of the fluke near the peduncle attachment point.
